title.en: Tale 2 — The Coat at the Feast

book_meta.author: traditional
book_meta.status: public domain — folk material, no known author

sentences.ar: جحا راح على عزيمة بلبس قديم.
sentences.en: Juha went to a feast in old clothes.

sentences.ar: محدا سلم عليه ولا حدا قعّده.
sentences.en: Nobody greeted him and nobody seated him.

sentences.ar: رجع عالبيت ولبس كبوت جديد وحلو.
sentences.en: He went home and put on a new, handsome coat.

sentences.ar: رجع عالعزيمة، وهلق كل الناس قامت إله.
sentences.en: He came back to the feast, and now everyone stood up for him.
They seated him in the place of honour and put the food in front of him.

sentences.ar: جحا مد كم الكبوت عالصحن وقال: كول يا كبوتي.
sentences.en: Juha put the coat sleeve to the plate and said: eat, my coat.
They asked him: what are you doing?
He said: the food is for the coat, not for me.
